_informational_only_doc: Per sub-task 5a.6 (Path C canonical realignment): these per-bracket per-axis caps were originally intended to drive bracket assignment in 5a.5, but have been DEMOTED to TRACK_ONLY (analytics-only diagnostic). The validator computes power_staple_counts per deck and surfaces them via the power_staple_diagnostic field, but `_assign_engine_bracket_v1` does NOT consult these caps in the bracket walk. The data is preserved for future analytics consumers.
